Subject: Vendor onboarding forms & proposal to move to Net 30

Hi David,

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday. We're close to finalizing internal approvals on our side, but AP asked if we can confirm Redwood's standard invoice cutoff and whether you're open to a Net 30 arrangement for the first 6 months. Right now we expect higher-than-usual onboarding spend during the pilot, and moving to Net 30 would really help cashflow on our end.

Attached are the completed vendor onboarding form and our W-9. Can you confirm: 1) the PO routing and whether your system requires any specific invoice reference (e.g., PO#, project code), and 2) whether Finance at Redwood will accept Net 30 for this customer pilot or if Net 45/60 is mandatory for new vendors?

Appreciate a quick confirmation so I can push this through AP.

Best,
Maria Ruiz
Vendor Ops Lead, Velocity Health
ap: ap@velocityhealth.com

Attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form_VelocityHealth.xlsx (spreadsheet), W-9_VelocityHealth.pdf (pdf)

Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 14:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding forms & proposal to move to Net 30

Hi Maria — thanks for sending these over and for the clear ask.

Short answers:
- PO routing: please include the PO number we issue (we'll send the PO after vendor activation) in the invoice header and put the project code in the invoice lines when relevant. Our accounting system looks for the PO# in the invoice number field for automated routing.
- Net terms: standard new vendor terms are Net 45, but for pilot customers we can evaluate Net 30 with a short approval from Finance and Legal.

I'm looping in Kimberly who handles Vendor Ops for exceptions; she can confirm the patchwork process and next steps. If you can confirm the billing contact and expected monthly invoice volume for the pilot, that will speed approvals.

I'll follow up once AP returns the PO.

Regards,
David Kim
Head of Partnerships (Sales Operations)
Redwood Inference

Hi Maria — great to meet you (virtually). Quick notes from Vendor Ops/Finance:

1) Invoice routing: send invoices to invoices@redwoodinference.com and reference the PO when it comes through. If you receive the PO as a PDF, put the PO number in the invoice "Reference" field and in the PDF filename. That avoids manual mapping during month-end.

2) Net terms exception: Finance is willing to approve Net 30 for the first two billing cycles of the pilot provided Velocity Health signs the onboarding agreement and we have completed our standard security/compliance checklist. After two cycles we will re-evaluate (likely revert to Net 45 unless there is a formal ARR commitment or prepayment arrangement).

3) Required docs: we have the W-9 and the onboarding spreadsheet you attached — we'll ingest those this morning. One more ask: can you provide an AP contact phone number and a billing email that accepts PDF invoices?

If you want to expedite the Net 30 approval, we can process a short "pilot terms" addendum; I'll send a draft once I have your billing contact and expected invoice cadence/volume.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park

Thanks for the context. Small operational points from Billing:
- Please flag "pilot-net30" in the PO when you issue it so AR knows to apply the accelerated schedule.
- We need Velocity Health's expected monthly invoice amount bracket (estimate) so we can set the payment run threshold and avoid manual queues. Brackets: < $5k, $5k-25k, > $25k.
- If Velocity wants guaranteed Net 30 beyond the trial, we'll need a short revenue commitment or a prepayment schedule (Finance prefers a revenue threshold to take on the cashflow hit).

Kimberly: once Maria shares the AP contact and the invoice bracket, can you generate the pilot addendum and route to Legal for a 24-hour review? I'll prioritize the AR cutover.
